The magic -e

The rule

In French, a final -e is not pronounced. English does the same thing: time is TIME, not TIME-uh.

But the English final -e is doing something while it sits there in silence. It reaches back and changes the vowel in front of it. That is why it is called the magic -e.

cap becomes cape  ·  kit becomes kite When a vowel is followed by one consonant and a final -e, the vowel is no longer silent, and pronounced the way you say the letter in the alphabet.

The five vowels

Click any word to hear it.

A   late E   scene I   line O   vote U   tune

Not this rule: words ending in -re such as wire, core, store and share follow a different rule, because the r changes the vowel itself. They are not covered on this page.

1 · The switch

Press the button, listen, and watch the vowel change.

nod
the o is short

2 · When the switch is broken

A double consonant blocks it

The magic only reaches back across one consonant. Put two in the way and the vowel stays short.

hide · I hidden · short i write · I written · short i bite · I bitten · short i

And some very common words simply refuse

There is no rule behind these. They are frequent enough that you will meet them constantly, so learn them as a small list.

have · HAV give · GIV live · LIV some · SUM come · KUM done · DUN none · NUN gone · GON

Two more sets that keep their final -e loud rather than silent: French borrowings ending in -é, said like the letter A (café, fiancé, cliché), and Greek borrowings, where it is a short i (apostrophe, psyche).

4 · Why the irregular verbs make sense

This is not only a spelling rule. It quietly explains a whole class of irregular verbs that look random until you notice the -e leaving and a consonant doubling.

InfinitivePastPast participleWhat happened
bite · I bit · short bitten · short -e gone, then double t
hide · I hid · short hidden · short -e gone, then double d
slide · I slid · short slid · short -e gone
write · I wrote · O written · short -e gone, then double t
drive · I drove · O driven · short -e gone, then double v sound
